scope: Collection routing for Phase 1; routes are planned destinations, not publication claims.

01 Ancient Histories.use: Authors and editions; bounded historical testimony; passage context

02 Assyrian Archives.use: Royal and documentary editions; historical claims; Kings and prophets context

03 Dead Sea Scrolls.use: Witness-specific transmission questions and contextual comparisons

04 Second Temple Literature.use: Identify editions and genres; contextual and comparative use

05 Canaanite and Egyptian Background.use: Historical and comparative cases with cultural context

06 Excavation Reports.use: Excavation methods, findings, alternatives and bounded passage context

07 Everyday Documents.use: Corpus browsing and document-specific social or linguistic context

08 Early Christian Writings.use: Attributed historical theology and early Christian testimony

09 Historical Geography.use: Atlas and context; proposed identifications retain uncertainty

10 Evidence Source Checks.use: Editorial evidence assessments and their source snapshots

11 Textual Witnesses.use: Edition and witness catalogue; transmission; reviewed passage comparisons

12 Biblical Language Data.use: Editorial lexical and morphological aids; not independent ancient witnesses

religions.use: Primary records of a named tradition; comparative use with edition and translation context

sermons.use: Attributed exposition and theological arguments; contributor remains in Teachers

library.use: Bibliographic discovery; select individual works for teaching or argument after review

bible.use: Existing Bible reader and edition-aware references

presentation.use: Atlas or presentation support; imagery and geographic basemaps are not scientific arguments

scienceGaps.scope: Laboratory and archaeological dating methods with datasets and uncertainty
